title: Red-Nosed Reports
description: Check reactor reports for safe monotonic level sequences.
writeup:
## Approach

Each report is a sequence of integer levels. A report is "safe" if the levels are strictly increasing or strictly decreasing, and every consecutive pair differs by 1 to 3.

## Part 1

Check each report directly against the safety criteria. Compute consecutive differences and verify they are all positive (or all negative) and within bounds.

## Part 2

The Problem Dampener allows removing a single level. For each unsafe report, try removing each element one at a time and re-check. If any removal makes it safe, count it. This is O(n²) per report but reports are short so it's fast enough.
